## Change boundary

- Method/protocol/code change:
- Exogenous records added:
- Legacy v1 files affected:

## Publication checks

- [ ] Full commits and exact SHA-256 digests are used; branches are hints only.
- [ ] Published core records are additions, not edits or deletions.
- [ ] Optional logs/attachments have consent and contain no credentials, hidden
      reasoning, unrelated account history, or unlicensed private material.
- [ ] Missing authority evidence is reported as `not_assessed`, not approved.
- [ ] Scores are not presented as certificates, warranties, or authority.
- [ ] A repair or re-entry uses a new Candidate/run rather than rewriting evidence.
- [ ] The current draft method has not been exposed as builder treatment input.
- [ ] The full validation command set in `README.md` passes.

Negative and protocol-invalid outcomes belong in the registry; disclose rather than
remove them.
